primary.title: Tax-aware retirement income strategy: How to invest smartly in FDs, SCSS and debt funds to beat inflation
primary.summary: Inflation-driven shifts are reshaping tax-aware retirement income strategies, as fixed deposits alone are no longer sufficient to keep pace with inflation. Retirees need to invest in diversified, tax-efficient, and inflation-protected assets to secure a steady income.
